description: Evidence-graded directory of 95 target GenAI employers across seven employer types (frontier labs, Big Tech, GPU/inference neoclouds, Physical AI/robotics startups, safety/eval organisations, remote-first product employers, enterprises/GCCs, IT services and public sector), with ATS routing, sponsorship evidence, remote and India presence, plus seven official sponsor registers.
basis: Compiled from T0-27 (46 baseline employers and 7 sponsor registers), T0-24 (UK AISI), and expanded on 2026-11-19 with 48 verified employers and hiring/funding/restructuring signals from T0-43 (remote-first and India-remote employers), T0-50 (Thinking Machines Lab), T0-52 (Applied Scientist boards), T0-53/T0-54/T0-56/T0-63 (GPU/inference neoclouds and AI silicon), T0-60 (frontier safety and evaluation organisations), T0-64 (Physical AI and robotics), T0-65 (leadership boards) and T0-70 (November 2026 market pulse). Extract-only Grade A rows from T0-27 were downgraded to Grade B per ERRATA U49. Anthropic reflects ERRATA U52 (priced $83.00/share on 2026-11-18 and debuted on Nasdaq under ticker ANT on 2026-11-19). Historical open-role snapshots are dated; verify live requisitions on each employer's own board.

frontier-lab.label: Frontier labs
frontier-lab.description: Organisations training frontier models or operating dedicated frontier AI research labs.

big-tech.label: Big Tech and hyperscalers
big-tech.description: Large listed technology companies, cloud hyperscalers and chip or platform vendors.

ai-startup.label: AI-native startups and scale-ups
ai-startup.description: Venture-backed AI-product, data, tooling and applied-AI companies below frontier-lab scale.

enterprise.label: Enterprises and GCCs
enterprise.description: Non-technology enterprises (banks, retailers, industrials, federal contractors) and their India Global Capability Centres.

it-services.label: IT services and consultancies
it-services.description: Systems integrators, IT services firms and management or technology consultancies.

public-sector.label: Government and public sector
public-sector.description: Government departments, AI safety institutes and public-sector technology programmes.

other.label: Other technology and sovereign AI employers
other.description: Independent AI safety/evaluation research organisations, sovereign-linked AI platforms and cross-category technology employers.

sponsor_registers.name: US DOL OFLC LCA disclosure data
sponsor_registers.cadence: Quarterly per fiscal year (FY2025 complete; FY2026 to 2026-06-30 published)
sponsor_registers.holds: Employer-filed Labor Condition Applications (H-1B, H-1B1, E-3) with employer name, SOC code, job title, worksite, offered base wage and status, plus quarterly Selected Statistics PDFs.
sponsor_registers.limits: Filings are not hires; positions differ from LCA counts; legal entity names fragment; offered wages exclude equity.

sponsor_registers.name: USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub
sponsor_registers.cadence: Quarterly/annual (snippet covers FY2009 to FY2026 Q4; unverified directly)
sponsor_registers.holds: Employer-level H-1B initial and continuing petition approvals and denials by fiscal year.
sponsor_registers.limits: Reported five-day outage and missing data in March 2026; automated fetch bot-blocked in T0-27.

sponsor_registers.name: UK Register of Licensed Sponsors: Workers
sponsor_registers.cadence: Updated on most working days (page updated 2026-11-10; about 10.4 MB CSV)
sponsor_registers.holds: Licensed UK worker sponsor organisation name, town/city, county, licence rating and route.
sponsor_registers.limits: A licence confirms legal eligibility to sponsor, not an open vacancy or willingness to sponsor a specific role.

sponsor_registers.name: IND Public Register of Recognised Sponsors
sponsor_registers.holds: Organisations recognised by the Dutch IND to sponsor labour, highly skilled migrant, research and exchange permits.
sponsor_registers.limits: Recognition is not a vacancy; downgraded from T0-27 Grade A to B (Extract-only, corroborated via web search 2026-11-19).

sponsor_registers.limits: An LMIA is not an open job offer; Global Talent Stream referral partners were trimmed in September 2026. Downgraded from T0-27 Grade A to B (Extract-only, corroborated 2026-11-19).
